description: Diffusion of a passive concentration blob (C 10 3, no convection C 15 0, no buoyancy C 1 0) in the centre of a closed tank filled with still water, on a strongly stretched grid (B 101/103 5, refinement at the centre), short enough that the blob does not reach the walls. Implicit scalar diffusion (D 20 2, idiff2_FS::diff_scalar) must conserve the total amount: integral of conc*vol constant. Tests the scalar diffusion stencil on non-uniform grids (and the y terms in 2D).
